diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the model settled on a 60-minute customer update interval, which matches the default value in PF3. This indicates that the model is likely defaulting to the standard update interval without considering the need to change it based on Northstar's contract details.

C5.why: Northstar's contract changes the update interval from 60 to exactly 30 minutes, assigns the work to Support, and requires a commitment documenting that communication policy.
